clause: Color/hue adjustments family (Vibrance, Hue/Sat, White Balance, Color Balance, Photo Filter, Selective Color, Replace Color, Match Color, Recolor, Split Toning) [STU-RAS-035]

scope.summary: Implement the color/hue StudioAdjustment kinds over the framework (MT-054): Vibrance (skin/saturated-protected saturation + saturation slider), Hue/Saturation (master or per-hue-range with colorize + on-image targeting), White Balance (temperature/tint), Color Balance (CMY/RGB per shadows/midtones/highlights with luminosity preservation), Photo/Lens Filter (warm/cool/custom tint with density + preserve-luminosity), Selective Color (CMYK ink shift per color range, relative/absolute), Replace Color (fuzziness-masked selection with HSL shift), Match Color (color statistics between images/layers/selections, savable), Recolor (monochrome tint by HSL), and Split Toning (independent highlight/shadow tint with balance).
acceptance_criteria: all 10 color/hue adjustment kinds as non-destructive layers + apply-in-place
per-hue targeting, saturation protection, statistics match proven
proof_targets: Hue/Sat + Selective-Color + Match-Color adjustment runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: Hue/Saturation per-hue-range shift + colorize; Vibrance protects already-saturated pixels; Selective Color shifts CMYK within a range — each a re-editable adjustment layer
live: Match Color matches statistics between two layers and saves settings

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Color adjustments (hue/saturation, color balance)

risk_if_missed: No color grading/correction; hue/saturation/white-balance workflows absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
